cross_cutting.soundness: Acceptance is meaningful only relative to the validator's stated semantic relation and trust model.
cross_cutting.completeness: General semantic validation is undecidable; validators may reject correct translations or deliberately bound the search.
cross_cutting.definedness: Comparing successful result values alone is insufficient when the target can introduce new UB, failures, or effects.
cross_cutting.composition: Pass-local validation needs composable intermediate-language relations to support an end-to-end conclusion.
